text:
lucas: noticed deploybot auto-pinned SDK v4.2 for hosted api due to 502s from some grpc clients in eu-west-1. opening thread to coordinate rollback vs compatibility shim.

deploybot: auto-pin triggered: 5xx rate >1% over 5m from tcp-proxy logs for sdk-client-grpc. Pin applied: sdk=4.2 -> sdk=4.1 (block newer). Reason: tls handoff change in 4.2 that breaks older client cert chains.

maya: which customers affected? any enterprise tenants?

support: saw 4 distinct customers with errors; two enterprise tenants on dedicated plans. Support already issued temporary guidance: retry with rest-client fallback header.

lucas: are we sure it's TLS chain handling and not loadbalancer config?

tj: initial trace shows handshake aborted in the SDK layer post-upgrade path. We reproduced locally with old client (openssl1.0) against 4.2 endpoint. Failing cert verification step.

karin: options: 1) rollback SDK on hosted endpoints to 4.1 (fast, minimal infra risk) 2) add compatibility shim that accepts legacy cert chains (requires infra coord, 1-2 hours) 3) instruct customers to upgrade clients (not acceptable for immediate mitigation).

lucas: preference for quick rollback on hosted to reduce customer impact. Then schedule compatibility patch before next change window. 

maya: agree. For dedicated customers we need account-level opt-in; don't rollback their SDK unless they request. Support, flag the two enterprise tenants for manual outreach.

support: will open priority escalations and notify account owners.

lucas: @deploybot queue rollback for hosted api in eu-west-1 and us-east-1 only. Keep dedicated pools untouched. Add annotation "sdk-tls-compat-4.2-rollback" and TTL 8h.

deploybot: acknowledged. Command queued:
```
/deploy rollback sdk=4.2 -> sdk=4.1 --targets hosted-eu-west-1,hosted-us-east-1 --ttl 8h --annot "sdk-tls-compat-4.2-rollback"
```
deploybot: starting rollout in 2 minutes. Watch #eng-releases, #support, and #eng-network.

tj: I'll run client compatibility tests once rollback completes. Test matrix: openssl1.0, openssl1.1, boringssl, grpc-java old versions.

karin: also add a release note blurb: "Temporary rollback of SDK v4.2 on hosted regions due to TLS handshake regressions with legacy client stacks. Dedicated pools unaffected. Fix in progress." We'll include mitigation steps for customers.

deploybot: rollback progress: 1776543330 - 3/6 host groups complete in eu-west-1.

maya: support confirmed one enterprise tenant already restored after rollback. Good signal.

deploybot: rollback completed at 1776543460. All targeted hosted groups on sdk=4.1. TTL set to expire at 1776546860.

tj: post-rollback compatibility run results: openssl1.0 now passes, boringssl passes, grpc-java v1.30 still needs a minor client retry fix (low volume). I'll file a follow-up ticket.

karin: plan next steps:
- infra to build compatibility shim accepting legacy cert chains (estimate 2h)
- once shim validated on staging, schedule unpin in next change window (03:00 UTC) with staged canary -> regional rollforward
- update release notes and notify accounts again

lucas: thanks. Ticket me the follow-up and link support threads. Also let's add a metric alert for handshake-errors specifically for SDK TLS paths to avoid auto-pin thrash.

maya: will draft alert and add to runbook. Closing thread for the immediate rollback; keep updates here for shim progress. :slightly_smiling_face:
